  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Update" name="Production update"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Feedback" name="Customer feedback"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collab_Chainsaw">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Producer" name="Chainsaw producer" processRef="Process_Producer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Properties" name="Send properties" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="StartEvent_Properties" messageRef="Msg_Properties"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Update" name="Send update" sourceRef="SendTask_Update" targetRef="Participant_Customer" messageRef="Msg_Update"/>

  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Producer" name="Chainsaw production" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Properties" name="Customer properties received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Properties" messageRef="Msg_Properties"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_OrderParts" name="Order parts from various online sources (in parallel)"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_PartsArrived" name="Parts arrived">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_PartsArrived"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Prod_Split" name="Start production"/>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_Inspect" name="Inspect all parts manually"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Assemble" name="Assemble parts"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_FirstSaw" name="Send first chainsaw to customer" messageRef="Msg_FirstSaw"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Prod_Join" name="Production finished"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Update_Merge" name="Update loop merge"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_Update" name="Send production update to customer" messageRef="Msg_Update"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Update_Split" name="Production completed?" default="Flow_12"/>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_Feedback" name="Customer feedback received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Feedback" messageRef="Msg_Feedback"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Like" name="Customer likes first chainsaw?" default="Flow_16"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProduceRest" name="Produce remaining chainsaws of the order"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_OrderCompleted" name="Order completed"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_NotContinued" name="Order not continued"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Properties" targetRef="Task_OrderParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_OrderParts" targetRef="Event_PartsArrived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Event_PartsArrived" targetRef="Gateway_Prod_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Gateway_Prod_Split" targetRef="Task_Inspect"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Task_Inspect" targetRef="Task_Assemble"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Task_Assemble" targetRef="SendTask_FirstSaw"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="SendTask_FirstSaw" targetRef="Gateway_Prod_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="Gateway_Prod_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Update_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" sourceRef="Gateway_Update_Merge" targetRef="SendTask_Update"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="SendTask_Update" targetRef="Gateway_Update_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" name="Not yet completed" sourceRef="Gateway_Update_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Update_Merge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression>production not yet completed</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" name="Completed" sourceRef="Gateway_Update_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Prod_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Gateway_Prod_Join" targetRef="Event_Feedback"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Event_Feedback" targetRef="Gateway_Like"/>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_PartsArrived" name="Parts arrived"/>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Prod_Split" name="Start production"/>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_Inspect" name="Inspect all parts manually"/>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_Assemble" name="Assemble parts"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_FirstSaw" name="Send first chainsaw to customer" messageRef="Msg_FirstSaw"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Prod_Join" name="Production finished"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Update_Merge" name="Update loop merge"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_Update" name="Send production update to customer" messageRef="Msg_Update"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Update_Split" name="Production completed?" default="Flow_UpdateDone"/>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_Feedback" name="Customer feedback received">

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Order" targetRef="ReceiveTask_Properties"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="ReceiveTask_Properties" targetRef="UserTask_Record"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="UserTask_Record" targetRef="Task_OrderParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Task_OrderParts" targetRef="Event_PartsArrived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Event_PartsArrived" targetRef="Gateway_Prod_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Gateway_Prod_Split" targetRef="Task_Inspect"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="Task_Inspect" targetRef="Task_Assemble"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="Task_Assemble" targetRef="SendTask_FirstSaw"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" sourceRef="SendTask_FirstSaw" targetRef="Gateway_Prod_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Gateway_Prod_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Update_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Gateway_Update_Merge" targetRef="SendTask_Update"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="SendTask_Update" targetRef="Gateway_Update_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_UpdateLoop" name="Not yet completed" sourceRef="Gateway_Update_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Update_Merge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression>production not yet completed</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_UpdateDone" name="Completed" sourceRef="Gateway_Update_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Prod_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Gateway_Prod_Join" targetRef="Event_Feedback"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Event_Feedback" targetRef="Gateway_Like"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Liked" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Like" targetRef="Task_ProduceRest">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression>customer likes first chainsaw</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotLiked" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Like" targetRef="EndEvent_NotContinued"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="Task_ProduceRest" targetRef="EndEvent_OrderCompleted"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
